title: ETF 자동매수 장점 3가지 — DCA·매수 타이밍·습관과 수수료 위험
core_message: Automatic ETF buys implement regular investing and remove some behavioral timing decisions. They cannot eliminate market volatility, avoid transaction fees, guarantee brokerage order execution or outperform lump-sum under all scenarios. This short repeats principles in #85 and points to the same parent longform.
